Mural minutes use OpenAI. Gemini is available only with your own Gemini key.
Google bills your Gemini project. This key is encrypted locally and sent only to Google. Mural and OpenAI do not receive it. Local encryption cannot make a client-held key impossible to extract.
Google Gemini data and retention

Provider rules and project settings apply. Gemini resumption can retain conversation state, including audio, for up to 24 hours; a resumption handle is valid for 2 hours after termination. Grounded Google searches, when available, retain input and output for 30 days. Local encryption does not make a client-held API key impossible to extract.
